description: This file contains classes and methods implementing OAuth 1.0 protocol, including signature methods, request handling, token management, and utility functions for OAuth authentication.

classes.name: OAuthException
classes.description: Custom exception class for OAuth errors.

classes.name: OAuthConsumer
classes.description: Represents an OAuth consumer with key and secret.

classes.name: OAuthToken
classes.description: Represents an OAuth token with key and secret.

classes.name: OAuthSignatureMethod
classes.description: Abstract class for implementing signature methods.

classes.name: OAuthSignatureMethod_RSA_SHA1
classes.description: Abstract class for RSA-SHA1 signature method with key fetching.

classes.name: OAuthRequest
classes.description: Handles OAuth request creation, signing, and parameter management.

classes.name: OAuthServer
classes.description: Processes OAuth request tokens, access tokens, and request verification.

classes.name: OAuthDataStore
classes.description: Interface for data storage and retrieval of OAuth consumers and tokens.

classes.name: OAuthUtil
classes.description: Utility functions for encoding, header parsing, parameter parsing, and URL building.

methods.name: get_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the signature method (e.g., HMAC-SHA1).

methods.name: build_signature
methods.description: Builds the signature for a request based on the method.

methods.name: check_signature
methods.description: Verifies if a signature is correct.

methods.name: to_string
methods.description: Serializes OAuthToken to string.

methods.name: get_signature_base_string
methods.description: Generates the base string for signing requests.

methods.name: from_request
methods.description: Creates an OAuthRequest object from server variables.

methods.name: from_consumer_and_token
methods.description: Creates an OAuthRequest with consumer and token info.

methods.name: sign_request
methods.description: Signs the OAuthRequest with a signature method.

methods.name: build_signature
methods.description: Builds the signature for the request.

methods.name: get_normalized_http_method
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method in uppercase.

methods.name: get_normalized_http_url
methods.description: Returns the normalized URL scheme://host/path.

methods.name: to_url
methods.description: Returns the full URL with parameters.

methods.name: to_postdata
methods.description: Returns URL-encoded POST data.

methods.name: to_header
methods.description: Returns the OAuth Authorization header string.

methods.name: generate_timestamp
methods.description: Generates current timestamp.

methods.name: generate_nonce
methods.description: Generates a unique nonce.

methods.name: add_signature_method
methods.description: Adds a signature method to OAuthServer.

methods.name: fetch_request_token
methods.description: Processes request token request.

methods.name: fetch_access_token
methods.description: Processes access token request.

methods.name: verify_request
methods.description: Verifies an OAuth request.

methods.name: get_version
methods.description: Retrieves OAuth version from request.

methods.name: get_signature_method
methods.description: Determines the signature method used.

methods.name: get_consumer
methods.description: Retrieves consumer info based on consumer key.

methods.name: get_token
methods.description: Retrieves token info based on token key.

methods.name: check_signature
methods.description: Checks the validity of the request signature.

methods.name: check_timestamp
methods.description: Verifies timestamp is recent.

methods.name: check_nonce
methods.description: Ensures nonce is unique and not reused.

methods.name: lookup_consumer
methods.description: Looks up consumer by key (to be implemented).

methods.name: lookup_token
methods.description: Looks up token by key and type (to be implemented).

methods.name: lookup_nonce
methods.description: Checks if nonce has been used (to be implemented).

methods.name: new_request_token
methods.description: Creates a new request token (to be implemented).

methods.name: new_access_token
methods.description: Creates a new access token (to be implemented).

methods.name: urlencode_rfc3986
methods.description: Encodes input per RFC 3986.

methods.name: urldecode_rfc3986
methods.description: Decodes RFC 3986 encoded string.

methods.name: split_header
methods.description: Parses OAuth header into parameters.

methods.name: get_headers
methods.description: Retrieves HTTP headers.

methods.name: parse_parameters
methods.description: Parses URL or POST parameters into array.

methods.name: build_http_query
methods.description: Builds URL-encoded query string from parameters.
